Purposed options:

Option 1. Ban the use of bots of any kind on Voat.

Option 2. Allow bots only for private subverses but with the limitation of receiving no upvotes via automated posts to prevent upvote farming.

Option 3. Allow bots site wide but with the limitation of receiving no upvotes through automated posts AND inability to automatically post in a thread if the OP has blocked your bot. And yes, of course the blocked user can still manually post in your thread. Just not autopost.

 

Detailed explanation and motives:

I'm making this post because @kevdude asked me to elaborate on my rant against derram's anti-imgur bot.

Bots can be used to auto downvote users, spam the site, or push personal agendas. Various users have complained about receiving hundreds and thousands of downvotes over a single nite. This was done via bots. This issue was somewhat limited by implementing the inability to downvote content older than 7 days but there is still the possibility to downvote a person automatically 10-20 times every day with no effort on your own because a bot does it.

Auto-ban and auto ping bots ware made recently to annoy users. This was done as a joke that lasted for a day and most people laughed at it, me included, but it paints a picture of how easily bots can be abused and that there are many voaters capable of making such a bot.

Spam bots were made that spammed the crap out of v/videos and v/gifs mostly to the point where the janitors couldn't delete the amount that the bot was posting. I don't think the issue war really solved but simply temporarily stopped by deleting the bot accounts and making voat invite only.

And finally, agenda pushing bots. A bot could easily be made by CTR that warns you not to read "fake" news every time you post a breitbart.com article. And a little extra advice not to vote for trump. Would you like that? Would you consider it agenda pushing and spam?

 

Derram's bot is an example of agenda pushing bully bot. It seems like a harmless archiving bot but its more than that.

Derram has a personal axe to grind against imgur due to the allegations of imgur deleting gamergate images (not really true) and their "proximity" to reddit (meh, reddit has their own service). His "cultural war" as he calls it, has created a million unnecessary spam posts promoting catbox and archive.is on the grounds of imgur deleting images. And received a billion upvotes for it.

He wanted to complain about what SJW kotaku and similar sites in the gamergate sub without giving them clicks so he made the archive bot, and ended up pushing it site wide. The case of imgur deleting posts was a result of people making actual imgur posts instead of just uploading privately and posting to voat witch resulted in imgur user-base flagging posts they don't like. Who told you to make a full imgur post?

His gamergate bot powered crusade against imgur resulted in an endless army of people complaining and downvoating threads every time you make a post with imgur. It was always flowed by the suggestion of sli.mg use which now resulted in the complete destruction of the vote archive for the second time. Auto posting subtle complaints about someones posting habits is not offering an alternative. Its pure harassment.

Since everybody fell for the sli.mg meme, almost every picture that was ever posted to voat is now gone with just the thumbnail remaining. As far as pictures are concerned, voat is now a graveyard. There are users whose two year posting history was destroyed by the failure of sli.mg. Custom CSS in all subs failed too if you used sli.mg. I personally didn't lose much since i dont post porn or much images but i love clicking random subverses and looking at what some user posted 1.5 years ago. Well now its just a thumbnail. And its the same for any new user exploring voat, eager to find out what cool hidden stuff there is to find. A graveyard thanks to si.mg.

Sure, i cant blame derram's bot for all of it but it was the tip of the spear. It's actually kind of funny, that in the end, it is the imgur users that still have their pictures up.

 

The bottom line.

You may not believe me when i say derram bot is pushing personal GG agenda in a subtle manner, and you may even appreciate it as many users do, but consider the flowing:

There are over 30 common image hosing sites, and each would perhaps like some voat clicks. What if tomorrow people from those services each make their own bot shilling for their own service. And then no mater what service you use, EACH thread will have 29 automated massages with a "friendly" reminder not to use that particular service, complete with a cute gamer girl picture. Will it be spam then? And who will be the judge that says this guy is the spammer and that guy is just an innocent friendly bot?

Four years from now trump will be for reelection, maybe the opposition will fully realize the importance of having a voice on the internet and CTR will spam voat 10x harder than they did this year with "friendly" bots suggesting to get your news elsewhere than "xx" right leaning site. Will bots be spam then? And who will be the judge to say witch bot in particular is spam?

As you can see, if there are no rules, then there are no limits to who can make what kind of spammy bot. For this reason i'm suggesting that those rules and blocking tools be developed.

Option 1. Ban the use of bots of any kind on Voat.
